title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

About the Company

We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities.


Role Overview

This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. We cover stablecoins, on/off ramp and cross-border payments as well. Candidates with relevant experiences will be prioritized.


Key Responsibilities

Liquidity Management

  • Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets.
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance.
  • Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.


FX & Trading Operations

  • Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows.
  • Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing.
  • Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics.

Risk & Governance

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

Requirements

  • Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments.
  • Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices.
  • Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics.
  • Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack SR - Java/Angular
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Fullstack SR - Java/Angular em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Modelo de trabalho: remoto


Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Java 20, Spring Boot 3.3 e Angular 14.
  • Implementar comunicação assíncrona entre microserviços utilizando Kafka , criando produtores e consumidores que garantam a troca eficiente de mensagens.
  • Realizar testes automatizados e garantir a qualidade do código através de ferramentas de análise.
  • Participar de revisões de código, promovendo boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para a documentação técnica das APIs e sistemas desenvolvidos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para automação do desenvolvimento e entrega.
  • Trabalhar com containers e orquestração na nuvem para garantir a escalabilidade das aplicações.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Curso de graduação completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Sólida experiência nas seguintes tecnologias:
  • Java (mínimo versão 20), Angular (mínimo versão 14) e Spring Boot 3.3.x
  • Experiência prática com Apache Kafka
  • Elastic Search 7.17
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Qualidade e Testes: JUnit 5, Mockito, WireMock (Mock de serviços externos) e SonarQube
  • Ferramentas de Apoio: Maven, Lombok, SpringDoc, OpenAPI e Swagger
  • Infraestrutura e Cloud: Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, AWS SDK S3 e GitLab CI/CD


Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento prático no Design System do Governo Federal (GovBR DS / @govbr-ds/core) e integração SSO GovBR(OAuth2).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps e automação de ambientes.
  • Práticas com LLM/Prompts de IA.


Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Centro de Integração Empresa Escola - CIEE é uma instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos e de fins não econômicos, reconhecida como entidade de assistência social que, por meio de diversos programas, dentre eles o de aprendizagem e o estágio de estudantes, possibilita aos adolescentes e jovens uma formação integral, ingressando-os ao mundo do trabalho.


O CIEE tem um programa de diversidade que acolhe e respeita como você é e como quiser ser!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Construir e manter aplicações web (frontend e backend), além de definir boas práticas a serem adotadas pelo CIEE.
  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST, garantindo integração eficiente entre sistemas internos e externos.
  • Escrever testes unitários e revisar código (code review).
  • Traduzir requisitos, estórias e regras de negócio em soluções eficientes.
  • Definir arquitetura de software e banco de dados.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, refatorar e resolver débitos técnicos nos sistemas implantados.
  • Documentar todas as atividades desenvolvidas, fluxos, integrações e regras de negócio.
  • Estimar esforço, prazo e impedimentos para cada demanda.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planejamento, dailies, retrospectivas e revisões).
  • Direcionar estagiários e desenvolvedores na execução de demandas.
  • Manter arquivos, registros e controles da área atualizados e acessíveis.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino superior concluído em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência: em atividades de desenvolvimento de software.


  • Conhecimentos específicos: Linguagens e Frameworks (Domínio em ao menos uma linguagem de programação orientada a objetos: Java, PHP ou Python. Domínio de desenvolvimento web: HTML, CSS e JavaScript. Domínio de frameworks backend Spring Boot. Banco de Dados (Domínio com SQL e banco de dados relacional (Oracle ou MySQL) e Experiência com modelagem de dados.). Versionamento e Colaboração ( Git e fluxo de versionamento (commits, branches e pull requests). Integração e Arquitetura ( Domínio de APIs REST (criação e consumo) e Domínio com microsserviços e componentização). Qualidade de Software ( Experiência com testes unitários e Domínio com Clean Code e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.). Metodologia ( Experiência com métodos ágeis: Scrum e/ou Kanban)Infraestrutura (básico): Experiência com Docker (criação de imagens e containers) e Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.


Horário: 08:00 às 17:30 - segunda à sexta

title: Corretor parceiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Corretor parceiro em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Oportunidade

A Chegolá Consórcio está expandindo o programa Indicalá. Buscamos pessoas conectadas, com boa rede de contatos e que queiram monetizar suas conexões de forma simples e transparente. Como Parceiro Independente, seu papel é ser a ponte entre pessoas que desejam adquirir bens (imóveis, veículos ou investimentos) e nossas soluções de consórcio especializado.


O que você fará:

  • Identificar oportunidades: Perceber quem no seu círculo profissional,de amigos, familiares está planejando comprar um bem ou investir.
  • Indicar: Cadastrar os dados do interessado em nossa plataforma exclusiva.
  • Acompanhar: Monitorar o status da sua indicação através do seu painel de embaixador.


Diferenciais do Programa:

  • Não precisa ter conhecimento técnico: Você não precisa fechar o negócio nem ser técnico no assunto. Nosso time de especialistas assume o atendimento após a sua indicação.
  • Liberdade Total: Sem metas, sem cobranças e sem horários fixos. Você indica quando e se quiser.
  • Renda Escalável: Não há limite de indicações. Ganhe recompensass expressivas (ex: R$ 1.000 para cada R$ 200 mil em crédito contratado).
  • Custo Zero: A participação é 100% gratuita.


Perfil Desejado:

  • Profissionais que já atuam com público (corretores, vendedores, consultores financeiros, influenciadores locais).
  • Pessoas com perfil comunicativo e bom relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Quem busca uma fonte de receita complementar sem comprometer sua atividade principal.


Como participar:

Todos que tem interesse irão receber um convite para uma live explicativa do programa.

Recomendamos que também preencham ocadastro diretamente pelo link oficial do programa para liberar seu link exclusivo de indicador:

title: Interior Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Interior Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Como se candidatar

Lembrando que somos um escritorio de Arquitetura de Interiores somente.

Candidatos devem focar em enviar trabalhos de interiores desenvolvidos em AutoCAD SOMENTE - Interior Elevations, Reflected Ceiling/ Floor Pattern Plan.

Trabalhos desenvolvidos em Layout de Sketchup não são ideiais . Trabalhos estruturais, Elevaçoes Externas, Site Plans são bem-vindos, mas não essenciais para o escritório.

Renders são muito bem-vindos, mas procuro alguem que consiga desenvolver projetos executivos em AutoCAD.

Envie seu portfólio + uma breve apresentação para 



A Imbuia Interior Design é um escritório boutique de design de interiores focado em arquitetura de interiores com projetos em Palm Beach, Sarasota, Coastal GA e no sudeste dos Estados Unidos. Trabalhamos com residências de alto padrão — do projeto esquemático à documentação completa para obra — e buscamos alguém que genuinamente ama o que faz. Alguém que se interessa pela história das linguagens arquitetônicas, que tem prazer no detalhamento técnico e que quer crescer dentro de uma prática exigente e diversificada.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

  • Elaborar elevações internas, detalhes de marcenaria e documentação completa para obra no AutoCAD
  • Desenvolver modelos 3D e renders fotorrealistas em SketchUp + Render engine/ Post Production
  • Organizar schedules de FF&E, acabamentos e acompanhar coordenação com fornecedores
  • Participar de revisões de qualidade de pranchas e logs de RFI em projetos em obra
  • Desenvolver em estilos arquitetônicos distintos a cada projeto — aprendendo e aplicando com precisão
  • Coordenar remotamente com o principal designer e colaboradores externos em inglês


O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

  • Domínio do AutoCAD - Projetos executivos de INTERIORES em AutoCAD.
  • SketchUp
  • Formação em Arquitetura / Design de interiores.
  • Inglês avançado
  • Alto nível de detalhamento técnico
  • Paixão por arquitetura e história do design
  • Conhecimento em marcenaria
  • Renders (diferencial)


DETALHES DA VAGA

100% remoto — horário integral, sobreposição com fuso do leste americano (EST) necessária

Remuneração: valor/hora competitivo, compatível com experiência

Oportunidade real de crescimento dentro de um escritório em expansão

title: Master Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Master Data Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, is an example of how we’re scaling advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. From large-scale models to agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment, love solving real-world problems, and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future, this is your moment.

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an advanced technology services and solutions company that delivers lasting value for leading enterprises globally. Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions – we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today. Get to know and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.

-------------



Responsibilities


Master Data Operations

  • Manage day‑to‑day master data operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of assigned tasks.
  • Maintain vendor, material, and service master records (creation, updates, modifications, deletions) in alignment with SLA requirements across multiple regions.
  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.



Why join Genpact?

• Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

• Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

• Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities

• Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

• Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.


Genpact is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. Genpact is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

Furthermore, please do note that Genpact does not charge fees to process job applications and applicants are not required to pay to participate in our hiring process in any other way. Examples of such scams include purchasing a 'starter kit,' paying to apply, or purchasing equipment or training.

  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.

title: Corretor parceiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Corretor parceiro em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Oportunidade

A Chegolá Consórcio está expandindo o programa Indicalá. Buscamos pessoas conectadas, com boa rede de contatos e que queiram monetizar suas conexões de forma simples e transparente. Todos que tem interesse irão receber um convite para uma live explicativa do programa.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java | Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java | Pleno em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com boa autonomia, utilizando as tecnologias, frameworks e padrões adotados nos projetos da BU de Core Banking.
  • Analisar, compreender e evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações, avaliando componentes, integrações, estrutura, segurança e regras de negócio envolvidas.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir funcionalidades com foco em qualidade, desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade e aderência às necessidades do negócio.
  • Criar, manter e apoiar a evolução de testes manuais e automatizados, contribuindo para a confiabilidade das entregas e para a cobertura dos requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Participar ativamente da definição técnica das soluções, contribuindo com análises, sugestões de melhoria e apoio ao time na tomada de decisão.
  • Documentar implementações, fluxos, decisões técnicas e etapas do desenvolvimento, utilizando ferramentas de versionamento, rastreabilidade e documentação técnica.
  • Realizar detalhamento técnico de demandas em conjunto com clientes, analistas de negócio e demais áreas envolvidas, transformando requisitos funcionais em soluções viáveis, sustentáveis e aderentes à arquitetura definida.
  • Garantir a qualidade do software por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, revisão de código, padronização e uso adequado de frameworks, servidores de aplicação e ferramentas corporativas.
  • Atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, analistas, QA e áreas parceiras, promovendo alinhamento técnico e funcional ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e funcionais com time e cliente, apoiando o esclarecimento de dúvidas, o refinamento de escopo e a evolução contínua das soluções.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência com Java JDK 8 ou 17
  • Vivência com Spring Boot, JAX-WS, JAX-RS, CDI, JPA, JEE, JSF, EJB e AngularJS
  • Experiência com WildFly 11 e/ou 18
  • Conhecimento em construção e consumo de APIs REST e SOAP
  • Experiência com Keycloak , utilizando OAuth2 / OpenID Connect (Bearer Token)
  • Conhecimento sólido em JPA / Hibernate
  • Experiência com banco de dados Oracle
  • Vivência com Git
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento e princípios de design como SOLID
  • Vivência com Maven para build e gerenciamento de dependências
  • Experiência em análise, desenvolvimento, manutenção e sustentação de sistemas corporativos
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na análise e solução de problemas técnicos
  • Boa comunicação para interação com time técnico, áreas de negócio e clientes


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :


  • Vivência em sustentação, suporte e atendimento a clientes em ambientes corporativos
  • Experiência com SQL Server ou ORACLE
  • Conhecimento em Kafka para mensageria e integração entre sistemas
  • Atuação em times que utilizam Métodos Ágeis
  • Vivência no uso de Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao desenvolvimento de software , com foco em produtividade, apoio à análise técnica, documentação, testes e troubleshooting


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:


️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Centro de Integração Empresa Escola - CIEE é uma instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos e de fins não econômicos, reconhecida como entidade de assistência social que, por meio de diversos programas, dentre eles o de aprendizagem e o estágio de estudantes, possibilita aos adolescentes e jovens uma formação integral, ingressando-os ao mundo do trabalho.


O CIEE tem um programa de diversidade que acolhe e respeita como você é e como quiser ser!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conceber e manter funcionalidades em aplicações web (frontend e backend e escolher padrões e boas práticas para adoção pelo CIEE.
  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST, garantindo integração eficiente entre sistemas internos e externos.
  • Escrever testes unitários e revisar código (code review).
  • Entender requisitos, estórias e regras de negócio para direcionar e implementar soluções assertivas.
  • Atuar na proposição da arquitetura de software e banco de dados.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, analisar e implementar melhorias nos sistemas implantados.
  • Documentar todas as atividades desenvolvidas, fluxos, integrações e regras de negócio.
  • Estimar esforço, prazo e impedimentos para cada demanda.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planejamento, dailies, retrospectivas e revisões).
  • Orientar estagiários e desenvolvedores na execução de demandas técnicas.
  • Manter arquivos, registros e controles da área atualizados e acessíveis.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Escolaridade: Ensino superior concluído em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência: em atividades de desenvolvimento de software.


  • Conhecimentos específicos: Linguagens e Frameworks (Domínio em ao menos uma linguagem de programação orientada a objetos: Java, PHP ou Python. Experiência com desenvolvimento web: HTML, CSS e JavaScript. Desenvoltura com frameworks backend Spring Boot. Banco de Dados (Experiência com SQL e banco de dados relacional (Oracle ou MySQL) e Desenvoltura com modelagem de dados.). Versionamento e Colaboração ( Git e fluxo de versionamento (commits, branches e pull requests). Integração e Arquitetura ( Habilidade com APIs REST (criação e consumo) e Experiência com microsserviços e componentização). Qualidade de Software ( Desenvoltura com testes unitários e Habilidade com Clean Code e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.). Metodologia ( Experiência com métodos ágeis: Scrum e/ou Kanban)Infraestrutura (básico): Desenvoltura com Docker (criação de imagens e containers) e Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.


Conhecimentos Técnicos — Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Kubernetes (pods, deployments, services, ingresses).
  • Experiência em cloud pública (Oracle, AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Desenvoltura com frontend moderno: Angular.
  • Experiência com TDD/BDD e testes de integração.
  • Experiência com banco de dados não relacional (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Ferramentas de IA generativa

title: Gerente de projetos SAP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de projetos SAP em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Área: Projetos SAP | Reforma Tributária


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP para liderar iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à adequação dos sistemas e processos empresariais às exigências da Reforma Tributária brasileira.

O profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, governança e execução dos projetos, atuando como principal ponto de contato entre áreas de negócio, times de tecnologia, consultorias parceiras e fornecedores, garantindo a conformidade legal e o sucesso das entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos SAP relacionados à implementação dos requisitos da Reforma Tributária (CBS, IBS e demais impactos regulatórios).
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas, orçamento, riscos, dependências e indicadores dos projetos.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares compostas por consultores SAP, especialistas fiscais, desenvolvedores e usuários-chave.
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas de acompanhamento e reportar status para stakeholders e liderança.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre requisitos legais, processos de negócio e soluções sistêmicas.
  • Atuar na gestão de fornecedores e consultorias parceiras.
  • Liderar as fases de levantamento, desenho de solução, testes integrados, homologação e go-live.
  • Gerenciar riscos, impactos e mudanças de escopo, assegurando a governança do projeto.
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias para adequação fiscal e tributária nos ambientes SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência às metodologias de gestão de projetos adotadas pela organização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada como Gerente de Projetos SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação, rollout, conversão ou transformação SAP.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira nos processos de negócio e sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, SAP Activate ou similares).
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões executivas e apresentações para alta liderança.
  • Conhecimento dos processos fiscais e integrações entre módulos SAP.


Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária.
  • Experiência com soluções fiscais como DRC, Soficom, Tax One, Mastersaf, Synchro, Guepardo, Vertex ou similares.
  • Conhecimento dos módulos SAP FI, SD, MM e Tax.
  • Certificação PMP, PMI-ACP, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA.
  • Inglês avançado.


O que esperamos deste profissional

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão de negócio e experiência em projetos SAP de alta complexidade, capaz de conduzir iniciativas críticas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a organização.

title: Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM)
description:

Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM) $6 - $6/hourpayRequired Skills IMUAttention to DetailVideo CaptureAbout micro1 micro1 is the leading AI data lab for training frontier models and evaluating AI agents. Experts contribute their diverse subject matter knowledge across domains such as finance, healthcare, STEM engineering, and more. micro1 transforms that real-world expertise into high-quality training data, evaluations, and feedback loops that improve how AI systems learn, reason, and perform.

Our platform identifies and vets top talent through an AI recruiter, enabling high-quality expert contributions at scale. We aim to enable 1 billion people to do meaningful work by applying their expertise to AI. As our global expert network grows, micro1 is building the human intelligence layer for frontier AI.

Job Description

Job Title: Remote Smartphone Task Recorder (LATAM)

Job Type : Contractor | Remote

Eligible Locations : Mexico, Costa Rica, Panama, Dominican Republic, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Uruguay, Jamaica, Bahamas, and Barbados.



About the Role

We’re looking for remote contributors to help support the development of next-generation AI and robotics systems through smartphone-based video and motion data collection.

This is a flexible, paid remote opportunity where you’ll record simple real-world activities using your smartphone while following clear recording guidelines.

No advanced technical background is required, but attention to detail and consistency are important.


What You’ll Do

  • Record short videos of physical activities using your smartphone
  • Capture synchronized motion and video data during recording sessions
  • Follow simple step-by-step recording instructions and quality guidelines
  • Submit a minimum of 10 hours of approved video data per week
  • Communicate with the team regarding recording quality or task instructions
  • Complete a quick onboarding and device compatibility check

Requirements

  • Access to a compatible smartphone:
  • iPhone 11 or newer
  • Google Pixel 6 or newer
  • Samsung Galaxy S21 or newer
  • Ability to use a smartphone head strap for hands-free recording within 48 hours of onboarding
  • Comfortable performing repetitive movement-based recording tasks
  • Reliable internet connection and communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured instructions
  • Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.


Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .


Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding.


Equipment Requirements

Mobile:

Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.


Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.

description:

Lembrando que somos um escritorio de Arquitetura de Interiores somente.

title: Corretor parceiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Corretor parceiro em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Oportunidade

A Chegolá Consórcio está expandindo o programa Indicalá. Buscamos pessoas conectadas, com boa rede de contatos e que queiram monetizar suas conexões de forma simples e transparente. Como Parceiro Independente, seu papel é ser a ponte entre pessoas que desejam adquirir bens (imóveis, veículos ou investimentos) e nossas soluções de consórcio especializado.


O que você fará:

  • Liberdade Total: Sem metas, sem cobranças e sem horários fixos. Você indica quando e se quiser.
  • Renda Escalável: Não há limite de indicações. Ganhe recompensass expressivas (ex: R$ 1.000 para cada R$ 200 mil em crédito contratado).
  • Custo Zero: A participação é 100% gratuita.


Perfil Desejado:

  • Profissionais que já atuam com público (corretores, vendedores, consultores financeiros, influenciadores locais).
  • Pessoas com perfil comunicativo e bom relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Quem busca uma fonte de receita complementar sem comprometer sua atividade principal.


Como participar:

Todos que tem interesse irão receber um convite para uma live explicativa do programa.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.


About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities.
  • Track progress and make sure work is moving forward.
  • Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early.
  • Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations.
  • Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
  • Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented.
  • Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication.
  • Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution.
  • Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps.
  • Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.


Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk.
  • Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company.

Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Liderar o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações e serviços de alta performance utilizando Java e Micronaut .
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em microsserviços , mensageria e eventos utilizando Kafka .
  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas, responsivas e escaláveis com React e TypeScript .
  • Modelar, otimizar e manter bancos de dados PostgreSQL , garantindo performance e confiabilidade.
  • Definir e implementar padrões de segurança, observabilidade, monitoramento e resiliência em ambientes AWS .
  • Realizar code reviews, garantindo qualidade, manutenibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar a investigação e resolução de incidentes, conduzindo análises de causa raiz e ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, compartilhando conhecimento e apoiando o desenvolvimento de profissionais de diferentes níveis.
  • Participar ativamente de definições arquiteturais e decisões técnicas de longo prazo.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Experiência sólida com Java 11+ e frameworks modernos para desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços, preferencialmente Micronaut .
  • Domínio de React , TypeScript e conceitos modernos de desenvolvimento Front-End.
  • Experiência avançada com Apache Kafka , incluindo tópicos, partições, consumer groups, estratégias de processamento e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

title: Gerente de projetos SAP
description:

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Área: Projetos SAP | Reforma Tributária


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP para liderar iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à adequação dos sistemas e processos empresariais às exigências da Reforma Tributária brasileira.

O profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, governança e execução dos projetos, atuando como principal ponto de contato entre áreas de negócio, times de tecnologia, consultorias parceiras e fornecedores, garantindo a conformidade legal e o sucesso das entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos SAP relacionados à implementação dos requisitos da Reforma Tributária (CBS, IBS e demais impactos regulatórios).

  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares compostas por consultores SAP, especialistas fiscais, desenvolvedores e usuários-chave.

Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada como Gerente de Projetos SAP.

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão de negócio e experiência em projetos SAP de alta complexidade, capaz de conduzir iniciativas críticas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a organização.

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release
  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class


Required Experience

  • Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment
  • MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising
  • Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning
  • Data Literacy: Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers
  • Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists
  • Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process
  • Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward
  • High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Master Data Operations

  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.



Why join Genpact?

• Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

title: Gerente de projetos SAP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de projetos SAP em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Área: Projetos SAP | Reforma Tributária


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP para liderar iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à adequação dos sistemas e processos empresariais às exigências da Reforma Tributária brasileira.

O profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, governança e execução dos projetos, atuando como principal ponto de contato entre áreas de negócio, times de tecnologia, consultorias parceiras e fornecedores, garantindo a conformidade legal e o sucesso das entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos SAP relacionados à implementação dos requisitos da Reforma Tributária (CBS, IBS e demais impactos regulatórios).
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas, orçamento, riscos, dependências e indicadores dos projetos.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares compostas por consultores SAP, especialistas fiscais, desenvolvedores e usuários-chave.
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas de acompanhamento e reportar status para stakeholders e liderança.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre requisitos legais, processos de negócio e soluções sistêmicas.
  • Atuar na gestão de fornecedores e consultorias parceiras.
  • Liderar as fases de levantamento, desenho de solução, testes integrados, homologação e go-live.
  • Gerenciar riscos, impactos e mudanças de escopo, assegurando a governança do projeto.
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias para adequação fiscal e tributária nos ambientes SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência às metodologias de gestão de projetos adotadas pela organização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada como Gerente de Projetos SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação, rollout, conversão ou transformação SAP.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira nos processos de negócio e sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, SAP Activate ou similares).
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões executivas e apresentações para alta liderança.
  • Conhecimento dos processos fiscais e integrações entre módulos SAP.


Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária.
  • Experiência com soluções fiscais como DRC, Soficom, Tax One, Mastersaf, Synchro, Guepardo, Vertex ou similares.
  • Conhecimento dos módulos SAP FI, SD, MM e Tax.
  • Certificação PMP, PMI-ACP, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA.
  • Inglês avançado.


O que esperamos deste profissional

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão de negócio e experiência em projetos SAP de alta complexidade, capaz de conduzir iniciativas críticas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a organização.

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release
  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class


Required Experience

  • Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment
  • MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising
  • Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning
  • Data Literacy: Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers
  • Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists
  • Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process
  • Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward
  • High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

  • Conhecimento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira nos processos de negócio e sistemas corporativos.

  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, SAP Activate ou similares).

  • Conhecimento dos módulos SAP FI, SD, MM e Tax.
  • Certificação PMP, PMI-ACP, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA.
  • Inglês avançado.


O que esperamos deste profissional

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão de negócio e experiência em projetos SAP de alta complexidade, capaz de conduzir iniciativas críticas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a organização.

About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life.


Deliverables:

  • Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end.
